name: economical-observable-triggers
rules: Run the cheapest visible check that can falsify the proposed repair before escalating.
Repair locally once when the failure is new, bounded, and consistent with the current hypothesis.
Escalate after two distinct failed hypotheses or one verified cross-module contract conflict.
Clarify only when two plausible user choices produce materially different accepted states.
Split only independent file sets with an integration check; keep shared-contract work serial.
Invoke the Controller only after an observable constraint falsification that the floor repair cannot resolve.
Stop with a resumable record when the worst-case next reservation does not fit.
